title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): AI and Copilot Upskilling Nudges in Microsoft Teams by Learning Agent
description: Learning Agent proactively delivers personalized AI and Copilot upskilling notifications through Microsoft Teams, helping users discover relevant learning opportunities in their flow of work. These notifications are tailored to users' roles, Copilot adoption stages, and usage patterns, guiding them toward practical scenarios and skills they can apply in everyday tasks.
